text:
Vincent Schaefer's co-patentee on the 1947 "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion" was most likely Katharine B. Blodgett, his General Electric colleague. This matches the team note, and it fits my recollection that Blodgett's patent list includes a joint patent with Schaefer. It replaces my earlier guess of Bernard Vonnegut, who was Schaefer's cloud-seeding collaborator. I haven't checked the patent record myself.

CONFIDENCE: 72
